The *Bhadrāvudhamāṇavapucchāniddesa* (Cnd 16) is a canonical exegetical text belonging to the *Cūḷaniddesa* in the Pali Khuddaka Nikāya [SuttaCentral]. Rendered in English as the "Exposition of the Questions of the Student Bhadrāvudha", it provides a line-by-line commentary on the questions attributed to the student Bhadrāvudha [SuttaCentral]. The SuttaCentral database records two translations of the work in two languages [SuttaCentral].
